text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Bravo! You look wonderfully lovely!
And on top of that—

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
"I wonder why? I feel like she's cheering me on...
like she's giving me strength."

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Fufu, it's surely thanks to how hard you worked to win it for me...♪

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: I'll take good care of it! Thank you!
